sources.title: VPEC rises as top GaAs epiwafer supplier
sources.effective_period: Reported in 2021; underlying market-share measurement period not specified.
sources.locator: DIGITIMES article listing and lead; full article is paywalled.
sources.note: Reports VPEC emerged as the world's top GaAs epiwafer supplier. The associated listing says the claim was based on industry sources; it does not disclose the market-share denominator or methodology.
